responsibility: Provides shared code-generation helpers for the RISC-V vector extension outside the builtin-registration machinery. It contains utility routines for RVV constant-vector analysis, VL/VLMAX setup emission, SEW/LMUL ratio calculation, predicated/vector operation expansion scaffolding, scalar-move mask generation, and special helpers for tricky cases such as slide1 on RV32 with 64-bit elements, serving as the common runtime RTL-emission library used by RVV patterns and builtin expansion.
